authorization.decision: prepare the final separate governance instruments for the outstanding Stage 2ZH decisions
authorization.instrument: the owner's written Stage 2ZI instruction of 2026-11-14
authorization.scope: docs/research/stage2zi/ only; drafts and instruments only; no data access; no adoption; no appointment; no owner signature, date, or affirmation

deliverables.role: Adoption-ready major-version amendment of protocol section 8.2: the replaced hash sentence, section 8.2.1 clauses A-1 to A-5, the assigned version 2.0.0 with finding V-1, findings Y-1 and Y-2 as pre-amendment deviations, the rejection of the hash-only variant, and the adoption conditions

The seven proposed selections in decision form with every owner field blank, the seven 2ZD-4 values with their required qualifications, the consequences of C-N, the S-1 non-implication, and the separation from the other two instruments

The custodian appointment form: access scope, digest-only procedure, prohibited acts, append-only logging, separation from analysis, revocation, incident handling, the single opening point, and blank appointment fields

Independent validation of the 2ZH deliverables, the amendment against the versioning rules, the seven selections against the packet, the 2ZD-4 values against their sources, S-1 against D-02, E-2 and 26 bp as assumptions, every gate and register status, the discrepancy list, the NOT VERIFIED list, and the open questions

What the stage was authorized to do, what it did, what each instrument would resolve, the correct ordering of the two open Gate 2 inputs, what remains unauthorized, the six requirements for a Gate 2 opening, and the zero-access record

findings.summary: the protocol requires semantic versions and a manifest per version but carries no version string anywhere in its 896 lines
findings.treatment: the amendment assigns 2.0.0 as the first versioned form; the adopting statement must acknowledge that no 1.x existed

findings.summary: the amendment cannot itself edit section 8.2, because section 10.3 forbids changing a frozen artifact before adoption
findings.treatment: recorded; the adopting statement must authorize the text change as a separate step

findings.summary: Stage 2ZG cites packet section 7 issue I-2 for Q-1, but the packet contains no Q-1, no I-2, and no issue list in section 7
findings.treatment: flagged in the owner decision instrument row and note; the substance of Q-1 (the 26 bp label) is unaffected

findings.summary: 2ZD-4 has five fields in the packet and seven in the proposal, the additions being the resample count and the seed
findings.treatment: disclosed as a superset; it does not narrow the owner's five fields

findings.summary: the 90-day embargo is derived from 540 x 4h and its agreement is exact but contingent on the lookback staying in 4h bars
findings.treatment: the registration should record the derivation rather than the number

findings.summary: under R-b the four disclosed Stage 2ZC boundary open_time inspections are reserved contact; the amendment is prospective and does not legitimise them retroactively
findings.treatment: recorded as a pre-amendment deviation; not grandfathered, not erased, not minimised

findings.summary: the Stage 2ZC full-file SHA-256 digests also touched reserved bytes and are reserved contact under R-b; their computational value is untouched while their governance status is a pre-amendment deviation
findings.treatment: recorded as a pre-amendment deviation; after the amendment only the custodian may recompute them

findings.summary: protocol section 10.4 permits a pre-registered interpretation to resolve an ambiguity, so R-b is the stricter route rather than the only route
10,000 resamples and seed 20240101 appear in one prior recommendation only
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; the registration must disclose them as a comparability and reproducibility choice

findings.summary: no candidate specification contains an exit or holding rule, so dependence adequacy and embargo sufficiency stay conditional
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; a separate unresolved registration requirement, not the only one while C-N stands

hashing_procedure: SHA256 over the UTF-8 canonical JSON encoding (json.dumps, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) of this object with the self_hash field removed. The file is written with indent=2, sort_keys=True and a trailing newline.
nature: Governance instrument preparation only: one final protocol amendment, one owner decision instrument, one custodian appointment instrument, one independent validation report, and one authorization boundary. No reserved byte read, streamed, decoded, or hashed; no dataset file opened; no census, backtest, simulation, parameter fit, strategy experiment, cost or liquidity measurement, quote sampling, venue contact, order, or real-capital sizing. No predecessor document modified; no protocol or addendum text changed; no gate moved.
open_items: adoption of the amendment under protocol section 10.2, with a dated owner statement naming its hash and acknowledging finding V-1
ratification of the seven selections in a dated instrument
appointment of the custodian in writing, even where the owner is the custodian
settlement of finding Y-1 and finding Y-2 as recorded pre-amendment deviations, without grandfathering unless stated
a hypothesis, which C-N withholds and without which Gate 2 cannot be registered at all
a registered exit and holding policy, which becomes decisive once a hypothesis is named
the committed text change to section 8.2 and its own manifest, which adoption must authorize (finding V-2)
the planning DE and p_exec brackets at registration under E-2
an answer to T-5 on the 250 target

predecessor_manifest_verification.procedure: each predecessor manifest read, its self_hash recomputed with the same canonical procedure, and each referenced deliverable re-hashed and re-sized from current bytes

proposed_selections.2ZD-1: R-b (operative only after the amendment is adopted)
proposed_selections.2ZD-2: C-N (valid under packet section 6.2; D-11 caps primaries at one, which zero satisfies)

2ZD-4.custodian: the human owner under the logged custody procedure (recommendation, not appointment)
2ZD-4.opening: after the Gate 2 freeze and the Gate 4 audit, at Gate 5 only, once, logged

proposed_selections.Q-1: retain 26 bp as a labelled unmeasured proxy (question introduced by Stage 2ZG; not a packet field)
proposed_selections.status: proposed and unratified; no owner field completed anywhere

status_after_stage.candidates: both FEASIBILITY FAIL - INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES, frozen at v2.0.0
status_after_stage.custodian_role: defined only in the draft amendment; no custodian appointed
status_after_stage.gate2_blockers: B-1 open by decision (C-N names no hypothesis); B-2, B-3, B-4, B-5 resolve only on the owner acts; B-6 document production; the exit and holding policy remains an open registration input distinct from B-1
status_after_stage.protocol_version: unchanged; the amendment is unadopted and assigns 2.0.0 only on adoption
